steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Really? She wrote just one line?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: What would I get from lying to you? I have it right here, if you want to read it yourself.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: (Clears throat)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Nei zek laan taan mao, I heard you pissed nei ah je off so bad that he just up and zau maai?!

spans.text: off so bad that he just up and

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: That's it. Not even a sign off.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Pfft.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You found that funny?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: One, I didn't know she was capable of pulling off a cursive script when speed writing.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Two, did you not set the record straight after she personally slapped this letter onto your head, Commissioner Swire?

spans.text: Two, did you not set the record straight after she personally slapped this letter onto your head,

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Stinky rat! Do you think I would have come looking for you if she weren't avoiding me like the plague?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You didn't have to. The less we see each other, the better.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Y-you!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I hereby declare: this last finball in your bowl is now mine.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Go ahead. Consider it consolation for my inaccurate assumption.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You really love to understate things, don't you?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: How would you want me to phrase it, then? You clashed head-on with your grandfather in New Siesta—can't say I falsely accused you of that, can you?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Though... you think I should go have a chat with Hoshiguma?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You should, but it's not appropriate for you to do so.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I know, she's been avoiding me, and only calls me by my official title when she has to, but I'm sure we haven't become estranged or anything like that.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: After all, she needs to keep a low profile and avoid rousing any suspicion after all that's happened. Plus, she misunderstood me and is kind of awkward about it now, and one of her elders has passed too...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: She's not that sensitive.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Really? I feel she can be quite sentimental sometimes... well, not really, uh... how do I describe that...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Wait for Ch'en Hui-chieh to come back, and maybe she can help you brainstorm your answer.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Though what I mean is her current behavior might not be from overthinking. She's merely trying to mess with you.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: CAU! LO! SYU! STINKING RAT!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: We're thick as thieves, Hoshiguma and I. But she's not one bit as cunning and petty as you!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I appreciate the compliment.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Thank you for the omiyage, Inspector Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No thanks necessary.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: While you were in Higashi, I happened to visit the Jiangqi jianbing shop quite a few times, and began to enjoy the taste of scallion.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I heard you encountered many unpleasant events in Mitsukue. I'm touched you still bothered to bring something back for me after all that.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's what I ought to do anyways.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Besides, I did stir up quite a ruckus in Mitsukue. I'd be sorry if the mess had affected you, Mr. Wei, or even Lungmen.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Not at all. What I have heard people talk about is your wisdom and courage. You not only cleared your own name, but also avenged Tessai-san, who was as a father to you.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: That Kinbee was never a good man. It was only natural for him to be arrested and put on trial. Fortunate for him that you have a good heart and didn't take his head.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...I still have a question for you.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: No need for formalities, just ask. You weren't this shy last time, when I was riding a little fast and you sideswiped me to force me to slow down.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Actually, ever since I came back from Mitsukue, I've been thinking...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Lungmen and Mitsukue... what is the difference between the two?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: How can I declare myself a Lungmenite with no hesitation, but I can't seem to consider Mitsukue my home any longer?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Because Mr. Lin manages the triads well? Because Lungmen has no so-called kami? No, that can't be it.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Hoshiguma, the most important thing in a city is the people. Real, living residents.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: People have dreams, and the dreams determine what sort of stories will happen within the boundaries of the city.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You mean...?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Lungmen has long since awoken from the dream Mitsukue is still in.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Fortunately, you managed to make some good friends over there.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They're probably the best part of my experience in Mitsukue.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Isn't that good enough?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I have a bizarre story to share with you too, Inspector.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I have heard that near to Mitsukue, in Himedo city, a young kyoukaku has appeared.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: He keeps his face hidden, and though his swordplay isn't stellar, he still manages to overpower his enemies with just a bokutou in hand.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: This young man who seemed ordinary eliminated a gang that had been committing fraud in the city for years.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: According to him, he walked all the way from Mitsukue to Himedo, and would rest no more than a few days there before embarking for the next city.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I hope his journey goes well.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: One more thing, which isn't as strange. But it has something to do with you.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: A police officer dismissed from his post in Mitsukue is now planning to run for diet office.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You think the old cop will make it?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Odds are ninety-nine percent, no. But should one just quit simply because it's difficult to achieve?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: True.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Alright, that's enough chatting for today, and we're pretty much done with the jianbing too. Time for the next round to begin.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I did notice you've switched to a new ride today, but my old pal won't give in without a fight.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I didn't expect the pressure to settle in even before I started my engine, Inspector.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Could it be your attire today?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Thirty-percent, maybe.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Here. Chikuwa, daikon, and burdenbeast tendon.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: How's the talent agency stuff going? Good?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Good and bad. But it's coming along nonetheless.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: I'm glad to hear that.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: You cried so much when Hoshiguma left, I thought you'd leave Mitsukue for Lungmen too.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I wasn't that down bad. Hoshiguma had her reasons to go, and I have my reasons to stay.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Hah, Momoka-san, I see you have already gained the air of a professional negotiator. And in such a short time.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Save it.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Tss—It's hot!

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Easy. There's no need to rush.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Phew... It's hot, but it tastes so good.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: You know, I might have to leave the city for a bit.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Going to that Rhodes Island Hoshiguma mentioned?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I know the Momoka name is already bound tight to me, down to my bones...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: But I still think maybe in a place where no one knows Momoka Hanyuu, Haruka Shino could live a little life of her own.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Hoshiguma will recognize you at least.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Don't cut in! I'm being serious!

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Haha. Alright, alright. Who knows, I might visit too, and make a few more friends myself.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Moriuchi-san, how long do you think we can live like this?

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: What's with the sudden topic change? I don't really get what you mean.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I can't explain it, but I feel like days like these are numbered.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Now I'm even more confused.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I mean... how do I put it? Nita Street is full of people every night, the skyscrapers in Kajimachi are almost finished, I walk down the street and nine out of ten people are talking about how housing prices are gonna go through the roof...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: All my shows have sold out in a single night, and I shake hands with fans until I grow calluses on my palms...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: But I get a feeling this will all come to an end pretty soon.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: What do you mean? War? An attack from the Northern Court?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: They might not have to make the first move. They might... be drawn into this by us.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Oh, someone's calling.

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Business?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: No, it's Kichisei.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Momoka, big news!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: What is it? Did the real estate market crash?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Ha? You still asleep? Didn't that new project hit a fresh high today? How could it crash?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: It's about Sarasa!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Sarasa? Didn't she leave Mitsukue soon after Tetsuya?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: She sent me a letter with her family crest on it. It's the Nishigori's!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: The Nishigori clan... from the Northern Court's Four Great Clans?!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: She said she had fun in Mitsukue, but the noise we made might have been a bit too loud, so she went back to Kusarikawa to hide from her family for a bit. Said she'd come back to look for us once it's safer!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: How's that for big news?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: That's... that's pretty big.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: She mentioned you too, and said she knows you're starting a talent agency—and she'd join, if it takes off.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: My agency? To be an idol? The princess of the Nishigori clan?!

steps.name: Moriuchi
steps.text: Momoka, ssh!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: If there's nothing else...
There's no rush.
Your work is consistent. More so than Mifune.
The Kinsekikai are under you now, but the Kinseki Group remains a hot potato with few willing to take over. Have you any interest in picking up his scraps and giving the Kinsekikai another chance?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: No, sir.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Indeed, picking up his legacy is rather easy in theory, but who knows how many hardships stand in the way.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Do you intend to remain like this for the rest of your days? A gang leader for a group that has lost their home turf?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I'm just creating a home for people who fell off society's ladder and doing a bit of clean up work.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Besides, there is no way I can possibly drag this on forever, if Mitsukue no longer needs the Kinsekikai.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I've had enough of both the Kinsekikai and the Kinseki Group.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I came here today to not only fulfill Mifune-san's promise to you, but to also inform you...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I have tried my best to deal with the Kinsekikai's aftermath, and now I bid my farewell.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: You've made up your mind, so I won't insist on changing it.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Alas. A beautiful face, but a heart icier than the fields of Ursus.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: I was trying to be kind, but she just wouldn't appreciate it. How rare.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Forget it. Let's take a look at the goods.
The paunchy diet member stands up in the luxurious reception room and walks toward a small door at the back.
Shockingly, the room past the door holds no confidential documents or precious metals.
Bereft of even entertainment facilities, it merely looks like a simple, sloppy room of a local.
Other than the old pachinko machine in the center of the room.
Having escaped destruction in Kajimachi, it is now connected to a dedicated circuit, emitting light and distorted music.
The diet member, who appeared quite dignified earlier, is jumping at the chance to have a try at the machine.
He lifts a huge basket of pachinko balls from the ground. Right before he inserts them into the machine, a voice sounds from behind it.

steps.name: Voice of a Kami
steps.text: Got your wish?

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Yes, yes. Kami-sama, thank you for your blessings! I am finally content!

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Thank you for showing up at my humble home after so long!

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: You stayed with me for so many years, but suddenly vanished the other day, and I was so worried! I thought you had abandoned me! Ah, happy returns!
The kami swiftly pounces onto the top of the machine.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: All that trouble just for this machine?

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Sure enough! I mean, I wouldn't have achieved all this without this machine. All thanks to your blessings!

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: I don't remember ever blessing you with anything.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Even if you didn't help me in recent years, your aid from twenty years ago was enough for the rest of my life!

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: That again?

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Indeed! The incident that turned me from a useless dreg into an impressive member of society!

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: I told you before, that had nothing to do with me either.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Hah, I don't believe you. Think about it, what sort of loser was I back then? A jobless hikkikomori unwilling to study or work... to borrow a trendy word of today—ah yes, a NEET.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Every day I begged my mother for coin to get a few pachinko rounds in. If I won, I'd consider myself lucky that day, or unlucky otherwise.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: But that day, that day my destiny changed—I saw you on the streets.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: I got nothing but wins that day. The pachinko balls flowed freely like water, and I even ran out of trays to carry them all!

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: And then?

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Then?

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Then I won a fortune 'big' enough to start a business on Nita Street. They were just pachinko balls after all. There was no way I could win more than the house.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: But you showed up, and it proved to me... I was no longer a loser.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: From that day on I believed strongly, I was blessed with fortune by you... looked after by a kami.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Had I not gotten blessed by you, how could I have won so much at pachinko, and used the earnings to speculate and profit till today?

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: I blessed you?

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: The past few days, you were gone, yes? I went through so many hurdles!

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: I asked that Kinbee to bring me back my pachinko machine. A simple job, no?

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: But I couldn't give the order directly, so I said, take over Kajimachi, come up with a redevelopment plan, and bring back this pachinko machine on the way back, because I have ties to it.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: And then everything went to shit. The Kajimachi gangs, the Lungmen cop, and even Kinbee's own artist... what a mess it was. The machine was almost lost to the chaos too.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: Fuzakeru na, if something happened to this machine you blessed, then what point is there turning that piece of rotten land by the river into Mitsukue's commercial center?

spans.text: if something happened to this machine you blessed, then what point is there turning that piece of rotten land by the river into Mitsukue's commercial center?

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: It's not just me, but the whole of Mitsukue too... all of Southern Court is under your watch, which is why we're developing so fast and how our property prices are soaring, right?

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: The Northern Court bumpkins are scrunching up their faces in anger, but they can't do anything about the fact you don't want to go over there.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: With you watching over us, we will surely improve, for...
A drop of sweat slides down his face. Not from nervousness, but his passion has gotten him heated up.

steps.name: Diet Member
steps.text: For... eternity!
And the kami looks down at him from the top of the machine...
Down at this secretly purchased thirty-floor high luxury apartment, with VIP-exclusive elevators...
Down at the almost hundred-meter high building, down at the clamor and chaos of Mitsukue...
And then It speaks a line It was tired of repeating, yet rarely taken seriously.

steps.name: Kami of Happy Returns
steps.text: What does any of that have to do with me?
The kami jumps out of the tiny room, but the diet member who finally succumbed to his want for a pachinko game does not notice Its exit.
He will never see the kami ever again after this day.

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: How long have they been talking?

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Three hours at least, and there's no signs it's ending. Can I go to the bathroom real quick—

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Don't even think about running away. You do know that you caused a huge commotion in Mitsukue, attracting two of the eight major family heads, and even nearly caused a dispute between the north and south, do you?

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Forget about my old man, at least that old deer from the Kanou can't do anything to you. You're a priest, after all.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Even if you're not one of the Eight Great Clans, your bloodline's pretty—

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Enough! You may no longer want to live, but you shouldn't drag your friends down with you!

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: You even sent them letters, saying you were planning to hide in Kusarikawa? They would've been in danger right now if you weren't here, *ahem*, performing dogeza.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Didn't you promise Momoka and the rest you'd risk your life to keep theirs safe? I'm sure you're a good man, so since you're so eager to help, I'm just going to the bathroom—

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Enough praises. The Kanou and Nishigori heads will be out here soon, and it'll all be fine if you stay, but if you run... heh.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: *sobs*...

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Are you hungry? I have some chikuwa here, you can have them if you want.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Arigatou...

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Um, kannushi-sama, I heard the shrine clergy mention you have a daughter?

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Yes, I do. She's a little younger than you.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: Are you as harsh with her as you were to me?
The priest is momentarily stunned, then looks at Sarasa as if she is a creature he cannot communicate with.

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Me? Harsh with Lisa? What are you thinking?

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: I mean, didn't she run away like I did? I'm still in Higashi, but she ran all the way to Siracusa!

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: About that...

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Ingrid can explain the whole thing to you if you meet her—
The door suddenly opens.
Fortunately, Sarasa noticed earlier the flickering light coming from the door gap, and returns to her dogeza pose right on time.
The priest immediately catches on, and straightens his back with head bowed, standing to the side.

steps.name: Male Ægir
steps.text: Now then. Allow me to once again apologize to you and the Kanou clan on behalf of the Nishigori clan. We are extremely sorry for the trouble caused by our failure to discipline our younger generation.

steps.name: Female Elafia
steps.text: Please, there is no need to exaggerate. The important issues are all settled, and I would like to thank your daughter for providing this opportunity for us to hold this discussion in person.

steps.name: Female Elafia
steps.text: Mitsukue has an incompetent diet member who allows violent gangs to run rampant, and your daughter merely acted in the name of justice. What wrong has she committed?

steps.name: Female Elafia
steps.text: As for the kami's whereabouts... if I may be so bold, I believe it is best to leave them to appear on their own terms for now...
The two clan leaders slowly stroll through the shrine's garden and towards the exit of the divine grounds, as if they have not noticed the two standing and kneeling behind them.

steps.name: Sarasa
steps.text: So... we're out of trouble?

steps.name: Unruffled Priest
steps.text: Technically, yes—

steps.name: Male Ægir
steps.text: It's time to head home, Sarasa.
The old Ægir casually calls out as he stands under the torii gate.
Sarasa freezes on the spot, her flushed cheeks from the joy of having gotten herself out of trouble turning pale.
She raises her head to look up at the little patch of sky encircled by the shrine, closes her eyes, and clenches her fists in a position where she believes her father cannot see...
Then, she puts on an obedient and emotionless expression as she follows her father's steps out of the shrine grounds.
